notes.title: Another Adventure Update
notes.content:
I added a level set "Another Adventure" that contains 100 new levels. I carefully picked the game objects to use and crafted the levels to provide as good puzzle gameplay as I could.

There are also other small changes:
- added options for changing fullscreen scale and y offset
- added an option for moving the item display to the right
- fixed a crash bug with rocket tiles

notes.title: Tiny update
notes.content:
- skipped levels are now marked with red text before they are completed
- level menu no longer scrolls automatically after beating a level
